entries.tactical_pattern_quoted: Have the learned model emit a structured, machine-checkable intermediate artifact at the decomposition boundary — an executable program, a formal domain/world model, a relational-or-constraint graph, a concrete state waypoint, an interleaved reason-act/tool-call trace, or a typed inter-agent deliverable — in place of a final answer, then route that artifact to a sound solver (interpreter, classical planner, constraint solver, MCTS/RL optimizer) or back through the model's own verify-and-revise loop. The load-bearing move is closing the loop with the solver's verifiable output — execution results, validator verdicts, behavioral consensus across independently sampled candidates, or terminal-answer confidence — and using that signal for credit assignment, candidate selection, or in-place correction applied DURING construction rather than only post-hoc.
